Name: Flickering Fists
Description: Your hands blur, becoming able to strike a creature with devastating vibrations. Make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d6 force damage, and they lose their reaction.
At Higher Levels: This spell's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).
